# Ruby Gillis

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P13](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P56](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0056)</sub>
- **Role:** teacher at the Carmody school (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060)</sub>  
  _previously: teacher (v1)_  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P23](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0023), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P34](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0034)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Ruby Gillis has a plump, showy figure with a brilliant complexion and large, bright-blue eyes. She is fair-skinned and features striking, long golden-yellow hair that she wears in a braid.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P3](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)_

## Personality

Ruby Gillis is a cheerful and good-tempered individual who enjoys the pleasant things in life, though she is prone to hysterics in stressful situations. Fixated on romance and young men, her primary motivation since childhood has been to attract numerous suitors, have a lively social life, and eventually marry after teaching for a couple of years. Additionally, she harbors a mortal dread of fat green caterpillars.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. ## History

Ruby Gillis grew up alongside [Anne](../character/anne.md), attending both school and Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) with her. As a child, Ruby charmed away her warts using a magic pebble from old [Mary Joe](../character/mary-joe.md) from the Creek, and she expressed an early desire to have dozens of beaus when she grew up. While at school, she joined a creative writing story club started by [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md), which also included [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md). After finishing her studies, Ruby's romantic endeavors became a subject of local gossip discussed by [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) back in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XV. >
> — Ruby Gillis — [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P1](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0001)

> "It makes me feel frightened, girls. Do you suppose it’s really right to act like this? Mrs. Lynde says that all play-acting is abominably wicked."
>
> — Ruby Gillis — [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P13](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0013)

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--ruby-gillis.md)

### [Jane](../character/jane.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/jane--ruby-gillis.md)
